teaser.en: Flip a leaf of this bush tree and it flashes silver, lined with fine veins as neat as ruled paper.
teaser.sw: Geuza jani la mti huu wa vichakani nalo litang'aa kama fedha, likiwa na mishipa membamba iliyopangika kama mistari ya daftari.
teaser.dg: Uchigaluza kodza ra muhi uhu wa weruni, rinang'ala dza feza, na rina mishipa midide minji iriyopangwa sawa-sawa dza mistari ya karatasi.

summary.en: *Msalasanga* is the broad-leaved resin tree, a bush shrub with silvery-backed leaves and a creamy resin. Its dark red wood is durable, and its bark, roots and twigs are used as medicine.
summary.sw: *Msalasanga* ni mwaalika, kichaka cha vichakani chenye majani yenye mgongo wa rangi ya fedha na utomvu wa rangi ya krimu. Mbao zake nyekundu iliyokolea hudumu muda mrefu, na gome, mizizi na vitawi vyake hutumika kama dawa.
summary.dg: *Msalasanga* ni *broad-leaved resin tree* kpwa Chingereza, chitsaka cha weruni chenye makodza ga rangi ya feza photsi na gamu ya rangi ya maziya. Nyama za muhi uhu ni za kundu sana na zinakala muda mure, na gophare, miziye na maphungoge nkuhumirwa dza dawa.

about.en: *Msalasanga* is a shrub or small tree with leathery leaves in groups of three. The undersides are silvery, crossed by fine, closely spaced parallel veins, so a breeze turning the leaves makes the crown shimmer. Cut the bark and a creamy resin oozes out. The small fruits are black and kidney-shaped.
about.sw: *Msalasanga* ni kichaka au mti mdogo wenye majani magumu kama ngozi yanayoota matatu matatu. Upande wa chini wa majani una rangi ya fedha, uliokatizwa na mishipa membamba sambamba iliyokaribiana sana, kwa hiyo upepo unapogeuza majani, taji lote hung'aa na kumetameta. Ukikata gome, utomvu wa rangi ya krimu hutoka. Matunda yake madogo ni meusi na yenye umbo la figo.
about.dg: *Msalasanga* ni chitsaka au muhi mdide wenye makodza magumu dza chingo, ganayomera mahahu-mahahu. Photsi makodza ni ga rangi ya feza, na gana mishipa midide minji iriyopangwa sawa-sawa na phephi-phephi; kpwa hivyo phepho richigaluza makodza, muhi wosi dzulu unang'ala-ng'ala. Uchikata gopha, gamu ya rangi ya maziya inatuluka. Matunda madide ni maru na ga umbo ra figo.

where.en: It grows in coastal bushland and wooded grassland.
where.sw: Huota katika vichaka vya pwani na nyika zenye miti.
where.dg: Unamera weruni pwani na kpwenye nyasi zenye mihi.

uses.en: The wood is dark red and durable. Bark, roots and twigs are used in traditional medicine, much as for its relative *Ozoroa insignis*.
uses.sw: Mbao zake ni nyekundu iliyokolea na hudumu muda mrefu. Gome, mizizi na vitawi hutumika katika dawa za kienyeji, kama ilivyo kwa jamaa yake *Ozoroa insignis*.
uses.dg: Nyama za muhi ni za kundu sana na zinakala muda mure. Gopha, mizi na maphungo nkuhumirwa kpwa dawa za chienyeji, dza vira aina ya phephi, *Ozoroa insignis*, inavyohumirwa.

names.en: Pakia records two Digo names, *msalasanga* and *msangasanga*; the second is shared with Duruma, and ICRAF gives *msalasanga*. In Swahili it is *mwaalika*, and in Giriama *mukuikwaiyu*. In English it is the broad-leaved resin tree.
names.sw: Pakia anarekodi majina mawili ya Kidigo, *msalasanga* na *msangasanga*; la pili linatumika pia katika Kiduruma, na ICRAF inatoa *msalasanga*. Kwa Kiswahili ni *mwaalika*, na kwa Kigiriama *mukuikwaiyu*. Kwa Kiingereza unaitwa *broad-leaved resin tree*.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika madzina mairi ga Chidigo, *msalasanga* na *msangasanga*; dzina ra phiri piya ni ra Chiduruma, na chitabu cha ICRAF chinapha *msalasanga*. Kpwa Chiswahili ni *mwaalika*, na kpwa Chigiriama ni *mukuikwaiyu*. Kpwa Chingereza ni *broad-leaved resin tree*.

reason.dg: Chitsaka chanjina cha weruni chenye gamu
